category_title: Children with expressive language difficulties and Sotos Syndrome who use persistent, roundabout communication strategies
scenario_title: Seeking attention to share an experience amidst distractions
minimal_context: Maliha is attempting to share her experience of seeing a theatre show with an educator who is busy managing other children in the outdoor play area.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am going to ride this tricycle around the outdoor play area now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Patting the educator's hand) Awa awa awa.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just a moment, I need to help this other child tie his shoelace first.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Jumping in joy) This is so much fun... my sister... a dad die. (Bending her body to play the role of 'die')

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What are you trying to say? I have to go listen to another child's complaint now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Widening her hands to stop the educator's tricycle) Son of lioking... pay ticket... (Claps her hands)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: I am going to ride this tricycle around the outdoor play area now.

STUDENT: (Patting the educator's hand) Awa awa awa.

task.content: Attempting to communicate a personal experience of seeing the 'Lion King' theatre show to an educator

context.social_setting: Educator is busy with other children who are asking for help or complaining

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the educator was busy with other children and riding a tricycle
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Stopping the educator's tricycle by widening her hands

behavior_patterns.condition: When trying to seek attention from a busy educator
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Kept following the educator, waiting until she finished a task, trying to touch, patting on hand, and saying 'Awa awa awa'
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Continuously searched for opportunities and tried different strategies to overcome social barriers
